question: To which of the following states does the dance form Laho belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The dance form Laho is an important part of the traditional culture of Meghalaya.
 
• It is performed during the festival of Shad Suk Mynsiem, which is celebrated by the Khasi tribe of Meghalaya.
 
• Laho dance involves both men and women dancing together, usually in a circular formation, with rhythmic steps and movements.
 
• It is a joyous and vibrant dance that showcases the rich cultural heritage of the Khasi tribe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meghalaya**

 
 
• Meghalaya is a state in northeastern India. It was formed by carving out two districts from the state of Assam in 1972.
 
• The name "Meghalaya" means "the abode of clouds" in Sanskrit.
 
• It is known for its rich cultural heritage, with a majority of the population belonging to the Khasi, Garo, and Jaintia tribes.
 
• Meghalaya is famous for its breathtaking landscapes, dense forests, and abundant rainfall. Cherrapunji and Mawsynram, located in Meghalaya, are among the wettest places on Earth.
 
 
 
• **Laho Dance**
 
 
• Laho is a traditional dance of the Khasi tribe in Meghalaya.
 
• It is performed during festivals and community gatherings, especially during the spring festival of Shad Suk Mynsiem.
 
• The dance involves alternating male and female dancers, who hold hands and move rhythmically to the beat of traditional drums and music.
 
• Laho is not just a dance but also a social event where the community comes together to celebrate and strengthen their cultural bonds.
 
 
 
• **Shad Suk Mynsiem**
 
 
• Shad Suk Mynsiem, also known as the "Dance of the Joyful Heart," is a major festival of the Khasi tribe in Meghalaya.
 
• It is celebrated in April, marking the beginning of the agricultural season.
 
• The festival features traditional dances, music, and rituals that express gratitude to the gods for a bountiful harvest and seek blessings for the upcoming season.
 
• The Laho dance is a prominent feature of this festival, symbolizing joy and unity among the community.
